subject.title: feat: add Pioneer.ai as an inference provider with live model discovery

question: Should OpenClaw accept Pioneer as an official provider now, with this auth/default/publishing surface and dependency graph change?
rationale: The remaining choice combines official provider ownership, supply-chain approval, and user-facing provider/model-picker behavior, which automation cannot choose permanently for maintainers.

options.title: Approve after narrowing
options.body: Keep the plugin path, but require the image-capability fix plus dependency/security approval or lockfile scrubbing before merge.

options.title: Accept official provider risk
options.body: Maintainers may explicitly own the new official provider, auth/default surface, live-discovery behavior, and dependency graph in this PR.

options.title: Route externally first
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish or maintain Pioneer through ClawHub/npm first and land only generic missing external-provider API improvements separately.

recommendation.title: Approve after narrowing
recommendation.body: Keep the plugin path, but require the image-capability fix plus dependency/security approval or lockfile scrubbing before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is official provider ownership plus provider/Gateway policy, and steipete has adjacent history across provider attribution, live catalog hardening, Gateway, and TUI behavior.
